```{r}
library(tidyverse)

candidate_paths <- c(
  "examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv",
  "../../examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv"
)

data_path <- candidate_paths[file.exists(candidate_paths)][1]
if (is.na(data_path)) {
  stop("Could not find examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv")
}

nhanes <- read_csv(data_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

bmi_by_income_cycle <- nhanes |>
  filter(
    !is.na(BMI),
    !is.na(IncomeGroup),
    !is.na(Cycle),
    Age >= 20,
    Age <= 80
  ) |>
  group_by(Cycle, IncomeGroup) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_bmi = mean(BMI),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 30)

bmi_by_income_cycle
```

```{r}
corrected_plot <- ggplot(
  bmi_by_income_cycle,
  aes(
    x = Cycle,
    y = mean_bmi,
    color = IncomeGroup,
    group = IncomeGroup
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Average BMI by income group across NHANES cycles",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Adults aged 20–80 in the prepared class dataset",
      "Unweighted means within each income group and cycle",
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    x = "NHANES survey cycle",
    y = expression("Mean BMI (kg/" * m^2 * ")"),
    color = "Income group",
    caption = paste(
      "Source: course-provided NHANES CSV snapshot.",
      "Exclusions: [replace with the actual exclusions in your preparation code].",
      "Means hide variation within groups; results are unweighted and are not population estimates.",
      "Lines connect group summaries across cycles, not individual participants.",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      hjust = 0,
      size = 9,
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    )
  )

corrected_plot
```
```{r}
dir.create(

ggsave(
```
